attestations.text: Chin Shih-tsung 金世宗 (personal name Yung 雍, 1123–1189), fifth Emperor of the Chin dynasty (1115–1234). Lin-ch'ing's family belonged to the Pao-i 包衣 or Imperial Household Bond-servant Division of the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.
